summary.name: Yandex Browser
summary.one_liner: Yandex Browser is a free web browser from Yandex that adds neural-network features such as phishing-site warnings, text writing help, and video summaries.
use_cases: reading and understanding text in different languages
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Yandex Browser as a neural browser that uses neural networks to help write texts, create pictures, understand different languages, read texts, and produce video summaries. It says the browser is trained to recognize phishing sites and warns users before they open one. According to a Softline study cited on the page, it detects phishing sites seven times better than other browsers. The page also claims it starts in about 3 seconds and handles a search query in 1.6 seconds, citing an independent Telecom Daily study. It can transfer data and settings from another browser during setup.
notable: Neural network phishing site warnings, with a claimed seven-times detection rate per a Softline study
Claimed startup in about 3 seconds and 1.6-second search query time per Telecom Daily
Imports data and settings from another browser
Separate builds for Apple processors and Intel processors
caveats: Performance and detection figures are vendor-cited from third-party studies, not independently verified here
Page lists only macOS download options; other platforms are not mentioned
